name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.212: The id-resolution give-up is gone. An item whose id could not be resolved used to be
    retired after three failed attempts, which meant the ladder never ran again for it; now the next
    run tries again, and the setting with its field is gone. The database refresh and the OSHash
    refresh each got a manual start button on the configuration page, under their own description,
    and their disabling option is now labelled "Manual" instead of "Never" - the stored value is
    unchanged, so an existing configuration keeps meaning what it meant. The upload postprocessing
    interval keeps "Never" because it has no such button.
  v12.1.12.212: The id-resolution give-up is gone. An item whose id could not be resolved used to be
    retired after three failed attempts, which meant the ladder never ran again for it; now the next
    run tries again. The setting and its field are gone with it. Also: the database and OSHash
    refreshes each got a manual start button on the configuration page, under their own description,
    so they can be run on the spot instead of waiting for the schedule. Both changes keep every
    existing cadence setting exactly as it was.
